Stage.LogText: {=sp_yd_s1_log}You encountered looters and one said your reputation is in danger. You were told to go to the barber in {GizemliSehir_Link} to learn the truth. Even though you put them to the sword, the seed of doubt grew within you. Find the barber in {GizemliSehir_Link} and ask 'What is the name of the looter?'.

{=sp_yd_s_success_log}You found the barber and asked him 'What is the name of the looter?'. He told you about the slanders against you. An old friend from your motherland, {Dost.Name}, asked for your help from the secret cult 'Scavenger Pigeons', of which he is a member. They gave you some money and told you to gather a party of 70 men and find the elder of a nearby village.

DialogNode.Text: {=sp_yd_dlg1}{PlayerName}! I finally found you. Being a looter is really hard.
{=sp_yd_dlg2}What is this nonsense, how do you know my name, you honorless scum?!

{=sp_yd_dlg3}Listen, this isn't some ordinary looter's foolish deception attempt, alright? Your reputation is in danger. I am a friend of a friend from your motherland. If you value your reputation, go to the barber of the second nearest city and ask 'What is the name of the looter?'. He will provide you with intel.
{=sp_yd_dlg4}A pathetic battle tactic. (Attack)
{=sp_yd_dlg5}Nice try. You have a knack for tactics.
{=sp_yd_dlg6}You believe me. I knew it!
{=sp_yd_dlg7}Maybe... One way or another, out of respect for your deception technique, I will release you.
{=sp_yd_dlg8}We shall see...
{=sp_yd_dlg9}Every word spoken holds importance. Yet, an honorless looter's head cannot stay on his shoulders! (Attack)
{=sp_yd_dlg10}What is the name of the looter?
{=sp_yd_dlg11}Anubis. Looters are the most suspicious birds of the realm. What did you want, stranger?
{=sp_yd_dlg12}The mysterious man dressed as a looter I spoke to said my reputation is in danger. I hope you aren't mocking me.
{=sp_yd_dlg13}The looter told me my reputation is in danger. What does this mean?

{=sp_yd_dlg14}Ahh, {PlayerName}... Your suspicious behavior is, of course, very justified. Don't worry. You did very well to believe him and come here. Your friend from your motherland, {Dost_Link}, contacted us. He mentioned that they started spreading rumors behind your back that could declare you a traitor.
{=sp_yd_dlg15}Who are you people? What kind of cult is this? Couldn't that idiot just send a regular messenger? Besides, I don't even know this man. Stop playing games.
{=sp_yd_dlg16}You? Are you a secret society? What is your problem?

{=sp_yd_dlg17}Don't worry friend. We are the Scavenger Pigeons, serving for centuries. We are faster than any messenger, stronger than any servant. Your friend is a brave man who has helped us a lot. He vouched for you and asked us to save you from this conspiracy.
{=sp_yd_dlg18}What do you want from me?

{=sp_yd_dlg19}As a token of our sincerity, we are gifting you some gold. Your old friend {Dost_Link} directed you to us for this purpose. Gather 70 men and find the village elder in the nearest village.
{=sp_yd_dlg20}I don't want your money. I'll also have to think a bit about taking a company of 70 men there.
{=sp_yd_dlg21}Thank you. I will gather that company with this money and meet with the village elder.
{=sp_yd_dlg22}I am no longer interested in this nonsense. Find someone else to entertain yourselves with.
{=sp_yd_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.
{=sp_yd_dlg23}Alright, see you later, baby pigeon...
